consumer: pickup.cpp::handle_problematic_pickup, which presents the Wear/Wield/Empty uilist and via amenu.query() asks the player which disposal action to perform on the too-heavy item
scope: only the character's own picked-up item and its avatar-local wear/wield/keep options
decisive_source: src/pickup.cpp::handle_problematic_pickup builds a uilist of WEAR/WIELD/EMPTY entries and resolves the player's choice through amenu.query() on the real input loop
divergence: An is_armor() item is too heavy: the backend silently auto-selects WEAR (or no-ops the pickup) instead of routing the player's actual menu choice, so a player who would have chosen 'skip' ends up wearing it, diverging from the real game's queried answer
